title: OLX India used cars, from a terminal and from an agent
hook:
₹0, 592 lines of Python, 1 dependency.

The whole tool, free: github.com/aswathas/olx-car-search
body:
OLX India has no public API, so I read the one its own frontend calls. Here is the whole ledger, nothing rounded:

- API key: ₹0
- Proxy: ₹0
- Account: ₹0
- Dependencies: 1, curl-cffi with a Chrome handshake
- HTTP clients that got through: 1 of 4
- OLX requests per search: 1
- Cars per response: 20
- Python: 592 lines, plus 152 of tests
- Tests: 8: 5 offline, 3 live, one full MCP round-trip
The obvious path was a scraping proxy. I never bought one, so I never found out what it costs. A proxy would have hidden the problem instead of solving it.

curl, Python requests and headless Chrome all got a connection reset from OLX — before a byte of HTML arrived. I watched Chrome fail with an HTTP2 protocol error instead of loading a page, and that is a TLS-layer problem wearing an HTTP costume. Chrome itself was blocked, which is the part that took me the longest to believe. curl-cffi sends a real Chrome handshake, so it got 200 OK and clean JSON.

The surprise came later. OLX ignores unknown query parameters silently, so a filter that does not exist looks exactly like a filter that worked. Nothing errors. The filter just returns everything. The only honest check was OLX's own applied filters echo in the response, so the tool prints it on every run.

136 used cars in Chennai between ₹3,00,000 and ₹6,00,000, 2018 onwards, in one request. Each car carries price, year, km, fuel, transmission, owner count, city, seller type and the live listing URL, so an agent can rank them without opening a browser.
Which layer burned you last: the handshake, the auth, or the rate limit?
cta: P.S. Public and MIT. It installs as a Claude Code plugin with one command.

evidence: olxcars/client.py - every OLX URL and query-parameter name in one module
curl_cffi requests.get(..., impersonate='chrome') - the only client that returned HTTP 200 from www.olx.in; curl, Python requests and headless Chrome were reset
tests/test_models.py - 5 offline tests; tests/test_live.py - 3 live tests including an MCP stdio round-trip
python -m pytest -q -> 5 passed, 3 skipped; OLXCARS_LIVE=1 python -m pytest -> 8 passed
Live search output: 20 of 136 cars for swift + chennai + price 300000-600000 + year_min 2018
